text:
Jordan: Heads-up — NebulaHealth reported ~40% request failures during morning ramp (07:50-08:05 PST). They say their dedicated pool didn’t scale up fast enough; seeing 429s and occasional 504s. CS flagged, routing to SRE/Platform.
Marta: Can you paste a couple of correlation ids and confirm region? Is this on dedicated-prod-nyc?
Jordan: Yes dedicated-prod-nyc, customer nebula-54. Example id: req_7f3a2b. Timeline: spike @07:51, first 429s @07:52, escalated by customer @07:55. They reported "rate_limit" then "service_unavailable" in sequence.
Ravi: I pulled autoscaler logs for nebula-54 — desired replicas jumped from 2 -> 10 at 07:52 but attach queue stalled. Key errors: "attach_heartbeat_missed" and a lot of "probe_backoff: imagepull-rate-limit". Looks like warm pool attach tokens exhausted.
Jordan: Customer claims reserved burst is enabled; still hit 429s even after burst window started.
Liu: K8s events show repeated ImagePullBackOff on warm-pool init containers. Registry QPS spiked; remote registry returning 429s. Attach handshake times out while imagepulls back off -> pods linger in Init:Attach. This ties autoscaler desired -> actual gap. Possible noisy tenant saturating registry throughput.
Amelie: Customer asks for repro steps and ETA. Can we give a temporary workaround within 30m?
Ravi: Short-term action plan: 1) Request infra to lift imagepull quota for the region, 2) bump min_replicas for nebula-54 from 2 -> 4, 3) enable immediate-burst (ten-minute window) to allow warm pool to provision faster. I’m patching the autoscaler and opening infra ticket now.
Marta: Drafting customer update.
Jordan: Repro attempt I ran against their route:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -v \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/nebula-54/generate\" -d '{"prompt":"x"}'
```
Response: 429 with body {"error":"rate_limit","retry_after":15} during spike.
Ravi: Patch applied: 
```bash
kubectl -n redwood-autoscaler patch deployment autoscaler-nebula-54 --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":4}]'
# enabled immediate-burst flag via configmap update
```
Jordan: New pods scheduled but several stuck: one stuck in Init:Attach ~2m with logs: "attach: waiting for heartbeat; last seen 125s ago"
Liu: Infra confirms registry throttling; opened ticket RG-321 to registry team. Also spotted a noisy tenant (x-corp) doing broad imagepulls from same pool — raising partner team ticket to throttle them.
autoscale-bot: Scale event recorded: desired=10 -> effective=7 due to attach_failures @4765432112
Ravi: Root cause summary: registry (imagepull) rate limit caused warm-pool init containers to back off, causing attach handshake/timeouts and preventing new replicas from becoming Ready, so autoscaler could not reach desired target. Contributing factor: low min_replicas and no rapid-warmup path when attach fails.
Liu: Medium-term fixes proposed: local registry caching for warmpool nodes, expose imagepull-throttle as a signal to autoscaler, and increase parallel attach tokens safely. Logged engineering tickets PLAT-879 (warmpool caching) and PLAT-880 (autoscaler backoff smoothing).
Amelie: Customer update sent: explained root cause and mitigations, offered 25% credit for the impacted window, and confirmed we’ll monitor for 2 hours. CS ok with that.
Jordan: Monitoring now — errors dropping after bump and registry quota bump from infra. Marking incident mitigated; follow-ups in eng-platform backlog. Thanks everyone :tada:
